lines.zh: 我一步一步压过来，很沉。
lines.en: I press forward step by step, heavy.
Crystal clinks as I move.

lines.zh: 我绕过矿坑，直直朝你走。
lines.en: I skirt the pit and head straight for you.

lines.zh: 我的脚踩碎了地上的矿渣。
lines.en: My feet crush the slag under them.
Slowly, not fast, but I never stop.

lines.zh: 我拖着身子，像一座小屋在挪。
lines.en: I drag myself along like a little house shifting.
I walk along the edge of the originium.

lines.zh: 我一动，周围的晶簇跟着响。
lines.en: When I move, the crystal clusters ring.

lines.zh: 我朝你的方向走了三步，停下。
lines.en: I take three steps your way and stop.
My six legs crush the slag underfoot.

lines.zh: 我站得很稳，一步就是一块地。
lines.en: I stand firm; each step claims ground.
I shove the blocking ore aside.

lines.zh: 我绕了一圈，把你围在中间。
lines.en: I circle once and put you in the middle.

lines.zh: 我一步一步靠近，没有犹豫。
lines.en: I close in step by step without hesitation.

lines.zh: 我的壳在动的时候发出闷响。
lines.en: My shell gives a dull ring when it moves.
I press over from the vein side.
I stand still, crystals trembling nearby.
My head is low, as if listening underground.
Crystals on my body grow slowly.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸带动周围的矿尘。
lines.en: My breathing stirs the ore dust.

lines.zh: 我伏在矿脉上，像块石头
lines.en: I crouch over the vein like a boulder.

lines.zh: 我的壳里传来矿石的响
lines.en: Ore grinds somewhere inside my shell.
All six of my legs are braced on the ground.
There is an old split in my shell.
I stay motionless like a lump of ore.
I tilt my head your way. The shell is heavy.
I am deciding which side to hit.
I give off a low vibration.
Come and try; are you strong enough?

lines.zh: 我这里守着的矿，不是你的。
lines.en: The ore I guard is not yours.
My crystals catch your face.
The Roamhouse shell stands taller than you.

lines.zh: 我身上的晶体，你碰不得。
lines.en: You must not touch the crystals on me.
A fight is required here.
You stand straight; that is rare.
I am waiting for someone who dares to strike.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸声我听得清楚。
lines.en: I hear your breathing clearly.
This vein is under my watch.
A piece of crystal falls off me.

lines.zh: 六百点生命，我走得比房子慢。
lines.en: Six hundred health, slower than a house.
You can cut me; good.

lines.zh: 六百点血的小屋，走得很慢。
lines.en: A six-hundred-point house, moving slowly.
A fine ticking comes from the split.
I push the cracked shell back into place.

lines.zh: 晶体从我伤口里长出来
lines.en: Crystals grow out of my wound.

lines.zh: 我把压坏的地方顶回去。
lines.en: I push the crushed part back into place.
My legs are struggling.
Your aim was true; not deep enough.
You want to mine this ore?
Your pick rings sharply.
The closer you come to the vein, the worse.
I have my eye on that iron tool.
Put the ore down and you may still leave.

lines.zh: 你身上的护甲挡不住我。
lines.en: Your armour will not stop me.
That lamp bleaches my crystals white.
You are walking this way; good.
In the mine you will not get far.
Bring your companions; that is better.

lines.zh: 我撞上你，你退了好几步。
lines.en: I crash into you and you stagger back.

lines.zh: 我的壳很硬，你的手麻了。
lines.en: My shell is hard and your hand goes numb.
You hit me like hitting a mountain.
One turn of my body shoves you off.
Crystals ring out at the impact.

lines.zh: 你撞得我腿甲咔了一声
lines.en: You knock a click out of my leg plate.

lines.zh: 你脚下一滑，靠在我身上。
lines.en: You slip and lean against me.

lines.zh: 我压过去，你退到矿渣上。
lines.en: I press in and you fall back on the slag.
After we part, the ground is cracked.
I put myself between you and the ore.
I am a guardian of the ore.
This vein holds only one.
This house walks with me.
That is an absurd question.
I rock my body slowly.
I care only for the ore.
No kin grow out of crystal.

lines.zh: 你该想的是怎么活着出去。
lines.en: You should be thinking of getting out alive.
A mine-keeping house takes no mate.
I lower my head, unwilling to bother.
I pin the ore under my weight.
I clamp it with my legs, firmly.
I bury it in the slag.
I grip it in my mouthparts and drag it.
This is under my watch.
I pick it up and keep it beneath me.
Your thing; I will keep it.
I cannot lift it, only push.
I slowly cover it over.
What falls in the mine belongs to the mine.
You, the one digging, are mine.
You are holding my ore.
I turn in your direction.
Either leave or fight.
I have locked this ground.
The one still digging is you.
I lower my body, ready.

lines.zh: 你的镐声停在哪儿，我知道
lines.en: I know where your pickaxe stopped.
I begin pressing toward you.
This fight is what you asked for.
I raise my front legs at you.
Do not count on escaping.

lines.zh: 我这身壳装了六百点血。
lines.en: This shell of mine holds six hundred health.
I stand between you and the vein.

lines.zh: 我一直在你和矿脉之间。
lines.en: I stay between you and the vein.
You go left, and I lean left too.
I am not fast, but I can block.

lines.zh: 你的镐声我听得很清楚。
lines.en: Your pick sounds clearly to me.
I move around behind you.

lines.zh: 你想要那块矿，得先过我。
lines.en: To get that ore, you must get past me.
I lower myself and hold the angle.

lines.zh: 你每挖一下，我就近一点。
lines.en: Every dig you make, I come closer.
I shake the crystals on my back.
Do not think of going round the far side.

lines.zh: 我前腿砸下去，地都震了。
lines.en: My front legs come down and the ground shakes.
I turn my flank into your chest.

lines.zh: 我的口器咬住你的护甲。
lines.en: My mouthparts clamp your armour.

lines.zh: 这一下把你推出去两格。
lines.en: That shoved you out two blocks.

lines.zh: 我的角撞在你肩上，很重。
lines.en: My horn hits your shoulder, heavy.
You blocked, but your legs are unsteady.

lines.zh: 这一下带着碎晶的锋利。
lines.en: That blow came with the sharpness of broken crystal.
I rear up and come down.
You are slammed against the ore wall.
That blow knocked your weapon away.

lines.zh: 矿脉深处传来一阵震动。
lines.en: A tremor comes from deep in the vein.
I push up from under the slag.

lines.zh: 晶体在我身上一寸寸亮。
lines.en: Crystal lights up on me inch by inch.

lines.zh: 你听见地面开裂的声音。
lines.en: You hear the ground splitting.

lines.zh: 我从洞壁的裂缝里挤出来。
lines.en: I squeeze out of a crack in the cave wall.

lines.zh: 我先是一条腿，然后是整个我。
lines.en: First one leg, then all of me.
This vein has woken up.
My shell pushes up out of the earth.
I land and ore dust billows.
The ground where you stand begins to glow.

lines.zh: 火烤着我的壳，晶都变色了。
lines.en: Fire bakes my shell and the crystals discolour.

lines.zh: 我从矿壁摔下，砸出一片坑。
lines.en: I fall off the ore wall and smash a pit.

lines.zh: 水灌进裂口，我动得很艰难。
lines.en: Water seeps into my cracks and I move with difficulty.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我翻开，露出里面的晶。
lines.en: The blast rolls me open, showing the crystal inside.
An arrow sticks in my shell and goes no deeper.

lines.zh: 法术打来，我的腿抖了一下。
lines.en: Magic hits and my legs shudder.

lines.zh: 太久没吃矿，我的壳发干。
lines.en: Too long without ore, my shell dries out.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，晶簇全亮了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and every crystal flares.

lines.zh: 虚空拽我，我抓不住矿脉。
lines.en: The void pulls and I cannot hold the vein.
